{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
{{Quote|The current debate stems over which zero-point year-notation system is the best, with the Great ReSynchronization of 13 years ago and the Ruusan Reformation of a millennium ago being popular contenders.|[[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]]|<ref name="HNN 45">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|life/13228_2.html|RM&S; Debates Calendar Reform}}</ref>}}
The '''Great ReSynchronization calendar''' was a dating system that was established in [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]] by the [[Republic Measures & Standards Bureau]] to recalibrate the disparate dating systems used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="HNN 45" /> This 12-month calendar used the [[Great ReSynchronization]] of 35 BBY as its zero point.<ref name="SWC">{{Blog|danwallace|3|Star Wars Calendars}}</ref> It was the main calendar used in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]].<ref name="HN">[[HoloNet News (Insider)|''Holonet News'']]</ref><ref name="GN">''[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]''</ref>

==Description==
The Great ReSynchronization calendar was a 12-month/368-day calendar,<ref name="MCBY">{{Blog|holocron|13/comments|Major Character Birth Years}}</ref> with months of 30 or 31 days.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

Dates using the ReSynchronization calendar were written in the following format:<ref name="SWC" />
:[Year]:[Month]:[Day]
:ex. [[22 BBY/Legends|13:5:21]]

Dates after ReSynchronization did not include trailing characters. Dates occurring before the ReSynchronization were followed by "BrS," for '''B'''efore '''R'''e'''S'''ynchonization:<ref name="SWC" />
:ex. [[5000 BBY/Legends|4,965 BrS]]

Based on this calendar, the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Naboo Crisis]] took place in year 3,<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] began in year 11,<ref name="HNN 45" /> the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]] took place in the year 13, the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] in the year 16, the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in the year 35, and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in the year 39.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
The Great ReSynchronization calendar was introduced in 35 BBY to replace the [[Unidentified calendar (Ruusan Reformation)|previous iteration]] of the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]], established one millennium earlier by the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]].<ref name="HNN 45" />

One decade later, the Ruusan calendar was still in use in the Republic. Thirteen years after the Great ReSynchronization, in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], debates occurred within the Republic regarding which zero-point calendar system — the ReSynchronization calendar or the Ruusan Reformation calendar — should be used.<ref name="HNN 45" /> The Great ReSynchronization calendar eventually emerged as the main dating system used in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in the next decades.<ref name="HN" /><ref name="GN" />

The calendar introduced with the Great ReSynchronization was still used during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] period and the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="GNN3">{{JournalCite|3|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>

Around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the Great ReSynchronization calendar was disbanded and reorganized by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] which preferred the [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|'ABY-BBY' dating system]], centered around the Battle of Yavin ([[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]/[[0 ABY/Legends|ABY]]).<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The dating scheme for the Great ReSynchronization calendar was introduced in [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' for its recurring in-universe articles ''[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]''. This dating system used the year 35 BBY at its zero point,<ref name="GNN3" /> which the [[1994]] reference book ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'' established as the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="AGttSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> As later sources placed the Clone Wars one decade later,<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Pablo Hidalgo]]'s ''[[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]]'' eventually [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] the year 35 BBY as the Great ReSynchronization to justify its use as a calendar zero point.<ref name="HNN 45" /><ref name="SWC" />
